content.short: Yolo Solos is a NFT text-based survival game, where each NFT is a character with unique traits used in the game.
content.description:
Enter a world where your decisions, grit, and individual style will determine how you fare against the wilderness. Can you survive? Do you have the skills, tools, and knowhow to thrive? In a land where the animals and elements can be your friends, foes, or food... you will find out all of this and more in the Yolo Solos Challenge.

Every Yolo Solo you mint will be a character you can play in the Yolo Solos Challenge. Each individual Solo has clothing, accessories, tools, and skills that makes him/her unique and provide him/her with special advantages and potential pitfalls to outperforming the other Solos in the game. As soon as you mint, you can start your Solo’s journey and read your daily survival report that will tell you the good, the bad, and the ugly of the decisions you made for that day!

Game play will allow you to have an impact on how your Solo performs. Your goal is to collect food and supplies, avoid injury, and maintain your resolve. You can choose on the map where you want them to go, what activity they attempt, and what tool they use. Tools, skills, animal companions, morale, boons, and even clothes are factors in determining success. If you choose not to play some of all of your characters, they will still participate in the game and you will be able to read the daily survival reports based on the decisions automatically generated from the game algorithm.
